capabilities: create templated notes when a configured supertag is typed on a line
replace the tagged line with a wikilink to the new note
collect sub-bullets under the tagged line as the new note's body
render supertags as colored chips in the editor
disambiguation: Not a tag manager; tags here only trigger creation of templated notes and are replaced with wikilinks.
extras: Beta-stage plugin installed via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases; README includes a feature-by-feature comparison table with Tana and a roadmap of planned features like inline field editing.
motivation: The author wanted to bring Tana's tag-to-node capture workflow to Obsidian, where notes stay as plain markdown files users own.
problem: Obsidian has no native way for a tag typed on a line to automatically spawn a fully structured, templated note as Tana's supertags do.

relations.evidence: Tana is a remarkable tool. SuperTags doesn't try to replicate it entirely

summary: Tag-triggered note creator that turns lines tagged with a configured supertag into pre-structured notes with custom frontmatter and body templates.
